sets.title: Day 1 — 2 April 2023, Crescent City to Bandon
sets.note: The first day of the Rendezvous, from Crescent Beach and Jedediah Smith State Park north along the Oregon coast.

sets.title: Day 2 — 3 April 2023, Bandon to Reedsport
sets.note: Seven Devils, South Slough, Cape Arago, Sunset Bay, the Hollering Place, the Coos History Museum, and the afternoon at the mouth of the Umpqua.

sets.title: Day 3 — 4 April 2023, Reedsport to Dallas
sets.note: Elk viewing, Fort Umpqua, and the inland route north through Drain, Curtin, Lorane, Monroe and the Soap Creek ford.

sets.title: Day 4 — 5 April 2023, Dallas to Fort Vancouver
sets.note: Champoeg, Willamette Falls and Fort Vancouver, ending at the Columbia.

sets.title: Rendezvous — general
sets.note: Two photographs filed above the four days.

sets.title: Bolon Island
sets.note: The original stone marker and the state highway panel that replaced it, photographed in June and July 2023 — the subject of the committee’s request to the Oregon Travel Information Council.

sets.title: Aerial photographs of the Smith River mouth, 1939–2002
sets.note: Twelve items: eight aerial frames and four scanned index sheets, dated 1939, 1945, 1954, 1968, 1976, 1986, 1994 and 2002. Aerial photography of this ground is how the site was located; the register keeps the entry, the images are not shown here.

sets.title: Canine search, 2 May 2023
sets.note: Six photographs made during the canine search for the trappers’ graves. Registered, dated and counted; not shown, and no location given.
